svg.text: claudia — front page: description and tags on documents, proposed

Based on the front page as built on branch one-server (D443, OpenDialog.vue): My places, Collections, Mine on top, search, the places' documents, the open form. Everything new is marked with a number.
Description (Markdown) and tags belong to the document, are indexed by search and readable without a password (D103: they join id, title and app type in the plain manifest).
A · The front page on a table app (computes) — "This computer" shown
Rows now carry a one-line description and tag chips; the place and time move to the right of the name. Hover a row to see its two actions: add to a collection (as today) and Details… (new).

g.text: Mine and the collections are kept

svg.text: Open a table, or start a new one. Everybody you invite works in the same table,
Search names, tags and descriptions on This computer and Mine
Excel, OpenDocument or Claudia tables, or drop one anywhere on this page.

text.tspan: Weekly hours per team, updated every
Titration series, raw readings and fits

svg.text: A new document belongs to whoever
A description, one line, shown under the name. Markdown inline only (bold, italic, code);
links, lists and images show in Details… but not in the list. Long ones are cut with "…".
Tags as chips, at most about two lines. Click a chip to filter the list by it (the filter
in 4 shows the active tag, click again to clear). Extra tags fold into "+2".
Search now also looks into tags and descriptions, on Mine and the place shown.
Hits are marked in the row (see B). Still ids/titles/tags/descriptions only: contents stay sealed.
The place list gets a second filter next to the app filter: all tags ▾ — a list of the
tags used on this place, with how often.
Row actions as today (collections) plus Details…: description and tags, see C.
Name, place and age move to the right of the name so the description fits.
No description: a muted "No description yet" keeps the row the same height and shows it can be added.
Whether others see it too is open: the list does not know who owns what (D103).
How a row looks with search hits, many tags, a long description and nothing at all.
Search "forecast": the hit is marked wherever it is
matched on the tag only: the chip is outlined, nothing in the text changes

text.tspan: Year-9 physics course, one deck per term; term 3 is still being rewritten and…

svg.text: Narrow window: the description is cut to one line; tags wrap to a second line, never more.
C · Details… (new) — edit description and tags
Opens from the row action, without opening the document. Owner edits; others see it read-only with a Close button.
The name is sealed into the file and cannot change.
Updated by finance each Friday; figures in EUR.
Markdown. Anybody who can see this place reads it, also without a password.
Updated by finance each Friday; figures in EUR.
Type, then Enter or comma. At most 10 tags.
Who may change them? Assumed: the owner only, with the password (as for delete). Alternative:
editors too, and no password on the front page — then Details… lives inside the document (File ▸ Properties…).
Public by design (D103): the dialog says so every time. Document marked unlisted: nothing shown
in the list or found by search, as the title is not. Descriptions are sanitised on the server and
in the page: no raw HTML, no images, links not clickable in the list.
Tags: lower-case, spaces allowed, at most ~10 per document and ~30 characters each; no hierarchy.
A change is a logged command ("SetDetails") so it shows in the history, but the plain manifest holds the current value.
Not drawn, for later: a tag cloud as a sidebar section, saved searches, tags shared across servers (a tag on
one server is just text; the list of tags is per place). Collections stay private and in the browser;
tags are public and part of the document — two different things, kept apart on purpose.
